description: Redesign the Job Details screen (lib/features/jobs/screens/job_detail_screen.dart) to match the premium reference mockup, reusing existing providers and job-shaped keys unchanged. Only the UI is restyled; jobDetailProvider, hasAppliedToJobProvider, jobSlotCountProvider, and jobsActionsProvider.applyToJob keep their exact signatures and behavior.
steps: Read lib/features/jobs/screens/job_detail_screen.dart in full first. It already wires jobDetailProvider(jobId), hasAppliedToJobProvider(jobId), jobSlotCountProvider(jobId) and an _ApplyBar that calls jobsActionsProvider.notifier.applyToJob(jobId). Preserve all of that logic; only restyle.

Read the job-shaped keys the screen consumes: title, description, category, payment_amount (num), max_slots (int? — null means Unlimited), deadline (parse via DateTime.tryParse), cover_image_url (String?), status (String), created_at (for 'Posted' relative time). Keep reading these exact keys.

Build a transparent app bar overlaid on the cover: back chevron (Iconsax.arrow_left or Icons.chevron_left) at left, centered title 'Job Details', a bookmark icon at right (use Iconsax.save_2 as the bookmark surrogate). App bar background transparent over the image; foreground/icon colors must stay legible in dark mode (put icons in soft circular buttons like PremiumIconButton with background:true, or tint by colorScheme).

Cover image: large ~200px height, rounded corners (AppRadius.allLg or allMd), showing job['cover_image_url']; when null/empty show a gradient placeholder (e.g. AppColors.primaryGradient). Overlay a status pill top-right in an ORANGE pill (AppColors.accentOrange bg) reading 'Active' when status=='active' else 'Closed'.
Job title: bold ~22-24 (AppTextStyles.h5 with FontWeight.w800 or a TextStyle fontSize 22-24), color dark-mode safe (Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface or AppColors dark/light textPrimary).

Category pill under the title: rounded light-grey background (AppColors.surfaceAlt / darkSurfaceAlt), small Iconsax.category (squaresFour) icon + the category label. Render only when category is non-null and non-empty.

Payment card: a card (white/darkCard, rounded, hairline border) with a wallet icon (Iconsax.wallet) inside a soft-orange rounded square (AppColors.accentOrange.withOpacity(0.12) bg), a small muted label 'Payment', the amount rendered LARGE and bold in AppColors.accentOrange formatted as e.g. '₹1,500' (use NumberFormat('#,##0')), and a muted subtitle 'Per approved submission'.

Details card: a card containing rows — Deadline (Iconsax.calendar, label left, value right formatted like 'd MMM y'; render only if deadline present), Slots (Iconsax.people, value right: '<remaining> of <max> slots left' when max_slots present, 'Slots Full' in AppColors.error/red when filled>=max, 'Unlimited' when max_slots is null), Posted (Iconsax.clock, relative time from created_at like '2 days ago' — implement a small helper that returns 'just now'/'N minutes ago'/'N hours ago'/'N days ago'/'N weeks ago'/'N months ago'). Use a thin divider between rows. All row text dark-mode safe.

Description & Instructions: a heading (bold) then the description body. Wrap the body in a small StatefulWidget or ConsumerStatefulWidget so 'Read more'/'Read less' actually toggles: collapse to ~4 lines by default (maxLines:4, overflow ellipsis) with a 'Read more' toggle in AppColors.accentOrange; expanded shows full text with 'Read less'. Only show the toggle when the text is long enough to overflow.

'What to submit' card: heading 'What to submit', muted subtitle 'Submit your work in any of the following formats:', then 4 outlined chips in a Wrap — Link (Iconsax.link), Photo (Iconsax.gallery), PDF (Iconsax.document), Video (Iconsax.video). Chips are outlined (transparent bg, hairline border, rounded), icon + label, dark-mode safe.

Sticky bottom bar (bottomNavigationBar): full-width rounded ORANGE 'Apply Now' button with a paper-plane icon (Iconsax.send_1). Reuse the existing _ApplyBar apply logic (setState _applying, applyToJob, success/error SnackBars, pop on success). Style the button orange (AppColors.accentOrange) — if PremiumButton supports a color/background param use it, otherwise wrap an orange-styled button. Keep the existing gating: when already applied show a disabled green 'Already Applied' state, when slots full show a disabled red 'Slots Full', when closed show disabled/hidden. The parent build() currently only shows _ApplyBar when (!hasApplied && !isFull && !isClosed) — you may either keep that gating in the parent and add the alternate disabled states, or move all states into the bottom bar; either way the visible states must be: Apply Now (orange) / Already Applied (green) / Slots Full (red) / Closed (disabled).
Keep loading (ShimmerLoading) and error (EmptyState with Retry invalidating jobDetailProvider) branches working.
Use AppSpacing / AppRadius / AppColors tokens throughout. Balance every brace/paren/bracket. Do NOT change any provider signature. Do NOT add any .eq('payout_model'...)/.neq(...) query.
acceptance_criteria: job_detail_screen.dart still watches jobDetailProvider(jobId), hasAppliedToJobProvider(jobId), jobSlotCountProvider(jobId) and calls jobsActionsProvider.notifier.applyToJob(jobId) with unchanged signatures.

Screen renders: cover image with orange status pill, title, category pill, Payment card with large orange amount and 'Per approved submission' subtitle, details card (Deadline / Slots / Posted with relative time), Description & Instructions with a working Read more/less toggle, 'What to submit' card with Link/Photo/PDF/Video chips, and a sticky bottom orange Apply Now button.
Read more/less toggle actually expands and collapses the description (stateful).
All text/icon colors are dark-mode safe (no hardcoded black/white text that breaks in dark mode).
All braces/parens/brackets balanced; file reads as valid Dart; no server-side payout_model query added.
verification: Read the full file back and confirm structure matches the acceptance criteria.
Count/balance braces, parens, brackets in the file.
grep for jobDetailProvider, hasAppliedToJobProvider, jobSlotCountProvider, applyToJob and confirm call sites/signatures unchanged.
grep the file (and lib/) for .eq('payout_model' and .neq('payout_model' — must be zero matches.
findings:
Fully rewrote lib/features/jobs/screens/job_detail_screen.dart to match the premium reference mockup. UI ONLY — providers untouched: still ref.watch(jobDetailProvider(jobId)), hasAppliedToJobProvider(jobId), jobSlotCountProvider(jobId) and calls ref.read(jobsActionsProvider.notifier).applyToJob(widget.jobId); error branch still invalidates jobDetailProvider(jobId). All original job-shaped keys read unchanged: title, description, category, payment_amount, max_slots (null=Unlimited), deadline (DateTime.tryParse), cover_image_url, status, created_at.

Structure implemented: (1) _CoverHeader Stack — 200px+topPad cover with AppColors.primaryGradient placeholder (briefcase icon), overlaid transparent app bar using PremiumIconButton(background:true, color white) for back (Iconsax.arrow_left) and bookmark (Iconsax.save_2) with centered 'Job Details' title, and an ORANGE (AppColors.accentOrange) status pill top-right reading Active/Closed. (2) Title h4 w800 size 23. (3) Category pill: surfaceAlt/darkSurfaceAlt pill with Iconsax.category, rendered only when non-empty. (4) _PaymentCard: soft-orange (0.12) rounded square with Iconsax.wallet, muted 'Payment' label, LARGE bold orange amount via NumberFormat('#,##0') as '₹1,500', 'Per approved submission' subtitle. (5) _DetailsCard: Deadline (Iconsax.calendar, 'd MMM y', only if present), Slots (Iconsax.people — '<remaining> of <max> slots left' / 'Slots Full' in AppColors.error when full / 'Unlimited' when max_slots null), Posted (Iconsax.clock, relative time helper just now/N minutes/hours/days/weeks/months ago from created_at), thin Dividers between rows. (6) Description & Instructions heading + _ExpandableText StatefulWidget: collapses to 4 lines, uses TextPainter didExceedMaxLines to show 'Read more'/'Read less' toggle in accentOrange only when overflowing — toggle genuinely expands/collapses via setState. (7) _WhatToSubmitCard: heading + muted subtitle + Wrap of 4 outlined chips Link/Photo/PDF/Video (Iconsax.link/gallery/document/video, transparent bg + hairline border). (8) Sticky bottomNavigationBar _ApplyBar with 4 visible states: Apply Now (orange _ApplyNowButton, Iconsax.send_1, preserves original setState _applying / applyToJob / success+error SnackBars / pop on success), Already Applied (green disabled), Slots Full (red disabled), Closed (neutral disabled). Moved state gating into the bottom bar (always rendered) instead of the parent's (!hasApplied && !isFull && !isClosed) so the alternate disabled states are visible. Loading (ShimmerLoading) and error (EmptyState + Retry) branches preserved verbatim.

Dark-mode safety: all text/icon colors gated on Theme.of(context).brightness via AppColors dark/light tokens (darkTextPrimary/Secondary, darkCard, darkBorder, darkSurfaceAlt) or fixed white only over the image/orange CTA where legible. No hardcoded black/white body text on theme surfaces.

Verification (Flutter not installed; static checks per context.verification_instructions): braces {}=67/67, parens ()=305/305, brackets []=42/42 all balanced (python count). Grep confirmed the 5 provider refs/call sites unchanged. Grep of lib/ for .eq('payout_model' / .neq('payout_model' → ZERO query matches (only an existing explanatory comment in campaigns_provider.dart). All 11 imports resolve to existing files. No provider signatures changed.
